title: Deform
tagline: Bend a whole body, or selected faces, onto the profile with the same map -- a flat-modelled insert, core feature or tip protector.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: Parts modelled flat must sit on the curved ski. Native Bend only flexes around an axis. Deform maps every vertex, edge and face through the bending map, so the part follows the profile exactly as a layer would.
useWhen: An insert or protector modelled flat
Features that must follow rocker / camber
Faces rather than a whole body
slides.caption: A 100 x 5 block bent onto the tip: bottom 100, top 99.2 (concave side).

points.head: Arc length kept
points.body: A point s along the From reference lands s along the To reference (a shift, no scaling).

points.head: Height and width kept
points.body: The point's offsets in the frame carry over: ribs stay perpendicular.

points.head: Layers bend
points.body: At height h around radius R they stretch or shrink by (R - h) / R, as a real layer does.

slides.title: The dialog
params: From edge(s) (G1 chain) and From reference (vertex, mate connector, plane).
To edge(s), Flip (reverse To), To reference, Flip normal.
Frenet (default) / Binormal (face, mate connector or world axis).
Sampling, degree, max control points, tolerance; Use face guide points; Keep wires.
Create wires / faces / bodies stages; show frames.

keys: A new body (the source stays); solids closed into solids.
messages: per-face WARNING / ERROR, OPEN END reports
Check for a missing face or a sheet instead of a solid.

items.head: Every face is a fill
items.body: Planes and cylinders are not kept as such; inner loops may fail.

items.head: Guide points
items.body: Turn on Use face guide points when fills do not follow the face.

items.head: Heavy
items.body: The slowest of the family: many edges, many projections.
